उत्पाद मैन्युअल
आई एस 302-2-35 : 2017 के अनुसार
घरेलु और समान विद्युत सावित्रों की सुरक्षा भाग 2 विशेष अपेक्षाएँ अनुभाग 35 विजली के पानी गमम करने के
वलए इोंस्टेंट हीटर (दूसरा पुनरीक्षण ) के वलए
दस्तािेज़ सोंख्या – पीएम/आईएस 302-2-35/1/जनिरी 2023
भारतीय मानक ब्यूरर की स्कीम-I (अनुरूपता मूलयााोंकन) विवनयम, 2018 के तहत यह उत्पाद मैन्युअल
प्रमाणीकरण के प्रचालन में रीवत और पाररवशमता की सुसोंगतता सुवनवित करने के वलए सभी क्षेत्ीय/शाखा
कायामलयरों और लाइसेंसी द्वारा सोंदभम सामग्री के रूप में उपयरग वकया जाएगा। िीआईएस प्रमाणीकरण
लाइसेंस/ प्रमाणपत् प्राप्त करने के इच्छुक भािी आिेदकरों द्वारा भी इस दस्तािेज़ का उपयरग वकया जा सकता
है ।

ANNEX A

Grouping Guidelines

1) Manufacturer shall declare the capacity, pollution degree, material group, rating in wattage,
input voltage, type, insulation class, degree of protection of Electric Instantaneous Water Heaters
produced by them with a model number.
2) For grant of licence/ change in scope of licence,
a) Samples of Electric Instantaneous Water Heaters of each model shall be tested
b) The following relaxation may be given when a model is tested for all the requirements:
 If a model with a particular degree of protection is tested, models with lower
degrees of protection may also be covered subject to condition that all other
parameters remain the same,
 In case two or more models differ only in aesthetics, i.e colour, visual design etc, only
one model may be tested subject to condition that all other parameters remain the same.
3) The Firm shall declare the models of Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters they intend
to cover in the Licence.
4) The Scope of Licence may be restricted based on the Manufacturing capability and Testing
facilities of the Manufacturer.
5) During the operation of the Licence, BO shall ensure that all the models covered in the Licence
are tested in rotation to the extent possible

ANNEX C

Scheme Of Inspection And Testing

1. LABORATORY - A laboratory shall be maintained which shall be suitably equipped (as per the requirement
given in column 2 of Table 1) and staffed, where different tests given in the specification shall be carried out in
accordance with the methods given in the specification.

1.1. The manufacturer shall prepare a calibration plan for the test equipment.

2. TEST RECORDS – The manufacturer shall maintain test records for the tests carried out to establish
conformity.

3. LABELLING AND MARKING – As per the requirements of IS 302-2-35 : 2017. In addition, the water heaters
shall also be marked with rated pressure in Pascals, color coding/ identification for inlet and outlets rods. Each
water heater shall be provided with the instruction manual for installation, operation and use, routine maintenance
and safety precautions. This shall also include values declared by the manufacturer in respect of relevant test
requirements.

4. CONTROL UNIT – All stationary storage type electric water heaters of each model manufactured in a week
or 500 stationary storage type electric water heaters of each model manufactured within a week, whichever is
less, shall constitute a control unit.

5. LEVELS OF CONTROL - The tests as indicated in column 1 of Table 1 and the levels of control in column
3 of Table 1, shall be carried out on the whole production of the factory which is covered by this plan and
appropriate records maintained in accordance with paragraph 2 above.

6. REJECTIONS – Disposal of non-conforming product shall be done in such a way so as to ensure that there is
no violation of provisions of BIS Act, 2016.

Note-1: Sub-contracting is permitted to a laboratory recognized by the Bureau or Government laboratories empaneled by the Bureau.
Note-2: For ensuring conformity of raw materials, further testing is not required if the consignment is accompanied by test certificate or ISI marked.
Note-3: In case of failure, all the water heaters in the control unit shall be tested and those found failing shall be rejected. Twice the number of samples
shall be tested from the subsequent control units for these requirements till samples from 5 consecutive control units pass. Thereafter, the original
frequency may be restored.
Note-4: In case of failure, the marking of that type & design shall be stopped and after a thorough investigation the defect shall be rectified. The
marking shall be resumed when samples of that type & design tested from the improved lot show conformity to the requirements.
Note-5: Levels of control given in column 3 are recommendatory in nature. The manufacturer may define the control unit/batch/lot and submit his own
levels of control in column 3 with proper justification for approval by BO Head.
